_A_NAVBAR_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ANavbar is a horizontal navigation: links, submenus with any number of levels, a logo and buttons in the slots. Items that do not fit go into the button "…", on a small screen the navigation opens in a drawer.
_A_NAVBAR_ACCESSIBILITY_: Accessibility: a nav landmark with a name and the WAI-ARIA pattern disclosure navigation (no menu roles). A submenu opens with a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, the current page has aria-current="page". Arrows move between the items, ArrowDown and ArrowRight open a level, ArrowLeft and Escape close it and give the focus back to its button. A click or the focus outside closes all submenus.
_A_NAVBAR_MOBILE_: Mobile: below the breakpoint of AMobilePlugin a button opens the navigation as accordion in ADrawer.
_A_NAVBAR_GROUP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Links with href or to, a button with a submenu (levels without limit), an item with a link and a submenu (split). isActive marks the current page and the way to it, the event navigate comes after a click on a link.
_A_NAVBAR_GROUP_OVERFLOW_DESCRIPTION_: more: the items that do not fit go into the button "…" (ResizeObserver). wrap: a second line. scroll: horizontal scroll.
_A_NAVBAR_GROUP_HOVER_DESCRIPTION_: With trigger="hover" the submenus open with open-delay and close with close-delay. The click and the keyboard still work.
_A_NAVBAR_GROUP_SLOT_ITEM_DESCRIPTION_: Own content of every item, e.g. a counter. The slot gets item, level, isOpen and isMore.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_CLOSE_DELAY_DESCRIPTION_: Delay (ms) before a submenu closes when the pointer leaves it (trigger hover).
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_DATA_DESCRIPTION_: The items: id, label, to, href, target, icon, isActive, disabled, children.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_DRAWER_PLACEMENT_DESCRIP: Side of the drawer on mobile: left or right.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Id of the navigation. The buttons and submenus get ids from it.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_IS_END_IN_DRAWER_DESCRIP: Mobile: the slot end is shown in the drawer instead of the bar.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_IS_MOBILE_MENU_DESCRIPTI: Mobile (AMobilePlugin): a button opens the navigation in a drawer. False: the bar on every screen.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_IS_STICKY_DESCRIPTION_: The bar stays at the top while the page scrolls.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_KEY_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the id of an item.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the text of an item.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: Name of the navigation landmark. Without it: the text navigation of texts.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_OPEN_DELAY_DESCRIPTION_: Delay (ms) before a submenu opens on hover (trigger hover).
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_OVERFLOW_DESCRIPTION_: What happens to the items that do not fit: more, wrap or scroll.
_A_NAVBAR_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPTION_: Own texts: drawer, more, navigation, submenu, toggle. A missing key falls back to the default.
_A_NAVBAR_EVENTS_NAVIGATE_DESCRIPTION_: After a click on a link: { item }. The submenus and the drawer are closed.
_A_NAVBAR_SLOTS_END_DESCRIPTION_: Content at the end of the bar, e.g. buttons.
_A_NAVBAR_SLOTS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION_: Own content of an item: { item, level, isOpen, isMore }.
_A_NAVBAR_SLOTS_START_DESCRIPTION_: Content at the start of the bar, e.g. a logo.
